{{Quote|You're a week early, ''Raptor''. And what happened to Captain Vless?|[[Cleben]], to [[Sacha Swiftbird]]|<ref name="The Last Jedi (novel)">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Vless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], running illicit supplies to the [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Kantaros Station]] in the [[Both system]].
